ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.changed: This question changed or closed while you were confirming. Check it, then try again.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.not_eligible: This copy of the app can't confirm answers as yours. Development builds and automated launches never can. Send it unconfirmed instead.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.not_running: This answer couldn't be confirmed as yours because the conversation isn't running. Send it unconfirmed, or open the conversation and confirm again.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.refused: The conversation didn't accept the confirmation. Send it unconfirmed, or open the conversation and confirm again.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.retry: The answer wasn't confirmed. Try again.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.window: Bring this window to the front, then confirm again.
ui.chat.ask_attest.sheet.consent_note: Confirming records this answer as given by you on this Mac, so the agent can treat it as your consent.
